_readme: The example decks the landing page shows, in gallery order. The first is the hero. name: the directory under examples/ and the path under /demo/. startBeat: the 0-based step on the first story slide where the poster, the loop and the live deck start (0 when omitted). provenance: agent (drafted by Claude Code, then edited by hand), talk (one of the talks Decks was extracted from), template or hand. run: the recorded agent run behind an agent deck, a fixture in fixtures/ written by scripts/excerpt-smoke.mjs, and setup: repo (this repository's own agent setup) or init (a fresh project set up with decks init). edits: the commit with the raw agent output and the commit with the hand edit, which scripts/edits.mjs diffs into fixtures/examples/<name>.edits.json. loop: true when make demo captures a hero loop into public/loops/.
